fatigue_fraction.source: Carbide fatigue / TRS: 0.33–0.42 fully reversed or 10⁶–10⁸ cycles (Schleinkofer 1996, Kursawe 2001, Brookes, Schedler via Preis 2004); 0.375 × 3.8 GPa = 1425 MPa adopted for C4 (Round 4); docs/research/carbide_and_edge_radius.md §2

edge_radius_mm.source: micro end mills 0.4–3.5 µm (Liang 2018; Jäckel 2024); no data vs diameter; not calibrated (C1 rarely binds above 1/32")

C2.basis: data/model_v2/chip_limits.json (band median of worst-flute h/D, eccentric runout at TIR 0.0002")
C2.source: confirmed on the hold-out rows against fitted alternatives (calibration_report.json c2)

aggressiveness.status: user decision 2026-10-17 (points accepted in principle); optimize.Margins(scheme='consensus')

scale_points.source: user 2026-10-17: 75 % ≈ vendor median (1.00), 50 % default 0.92 (Speedio BT30 starting point), 100 % 1.10 (vendors' 'may increase 10–20 %', e.g. Harvey speeds-feeds page), 0 % 0.76 (vendor lower quartile; worst-flute h/D p25/median 0.76, calibration_report.json)

applies_to: C7 speed level (the tool-life target as speed: T/T_ref = scale^(−1/n))
C14 caps on SFM, fz and MRR (scale × the bucket vendor median)

C4.source: × the fatigue limit 1425 MPa, never above it: 0.88 = 0.33/0.375 at a = 0 (Schleinkofer 1996, R = −1, via Preis 2004), 1.0 at a = 1; linear

C5_margin.source: unchanged; the spindle is a hard limit

vendor_spread_check.source: vendor-group median / bucket vendor median over L1 buckets with ≥ 3 groups

C14.source: Vendor consensus (user decision 2026-10-17): speed, chip load and MRR (per inch of depth) ≤ consensus_scale(a) × the vendor median of the matching bucket (family, hardness, diameter band, operation, engagement), data/model_v2/consensus.json from the benchmark rows; no matching vendor data → the physics result

k_spindle_n_um.source: NK Enginex ATC-BT30 spindle spec 'Radial stiffness ≥80 N/μm' (vendor minimum, not Brother; https://nkenginex.com/products/cnc-atc-bt30-spindle)

k_holder_joint_n_um.source: holder-tool joint k_yf 5.1581e7 N/m, carbide 16 mm tool in a BT40 holder (Özşahin, Ertürk, Özgüven, Budak 2009, IJMTM 49:25, Table 2)

ktheta_holder_joint_nm_urad.source: holder-tool joint k_θm 1.2631e5 N·m/rad, same paper and table; no size-30 taper rotational value was found

combined_k_n_um.source: series of the two translational values above

machine_bt30.status: PROVISIONAL BT30: spindle ≥80 N/µm (NK Enginex spec) in series with a holder-tool joint 51.6 N/µm and 0.126 N·m/µrad (Özşahin et al. 2009, BT40, 16 mm tool); measure on the Speedio
